descriptor_docs.attack: Stick contact energy, ~2.5-12 kHz, first ~12 ms.
descriptor_docs.body: Lower shimmer around ~950 Hz - 3.5 kHz — how much metal is heard rather than pure hiss.
descriptor_docs.sizzle: Air and sizzle above ~7.7 kHz, transient excluded.
descriptor_docs.bright: Balance of top-end sizzle against lower shimmer.
descriptor_docs.decay: Early-to-late energy ratio over ~12-255 ms — the closed/open axis. Higher = tightly closed, lower = open or pedal-splashed.
